Description: Cycle OrionTV.Desktop.App -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback -> OrionTV.Desktop.App. MainWindow uses PlayerView, PlayerView uses MpvLocalEngine and MpvHost, and MpvLocalEngine uses the PlaybackState enum declared in the root App namespace.

OrionTV.Desktop.App (I = 1/4: used by Views, Controls and LocalPlayback; depends only on Views) depends on the less stable OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views (I = 3/4: depends on App, LiveTranslation and LocalPlayback; used only by App).

The root App namespace holds about 40 types and several thousand lines of code. This includes the VodCacheService local HTTP server/downloader of about 1,500 lines, together with update service, AI CLI launcher, playback controller, keyboard hook, image loader, download manager, source health probe and navigation contracts.

Description: The media playback engine concern is spread over OrionTV.Desktop.App (PlaybackController wrapping LibVLC), OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback (MpvLocalEngine, MpvHost, PotPlayerLauncher) and OrionTV.Desktop.App.LiveTranslation (LibVlcAudioTap creating its own LibVLC player). App and LiveTranslation also carry other, orthogonal concerns.

Diagnostic file logging is implemented twice, independently: in OrionTV.Desktop.App.LiveTranslation (LiveTranslationLog) and in OrionTV.Desktop.App (VodCacheLog). Both namespaces are mainly responsible for other concerns (translation sessions, VOD caching).
